data.gender_notes: Atayat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is devoted to Allah and His Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The name Atayat carries the meaning “Devoted one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Atayat usually hope their child will grow to embody devoted one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of commitment and devotion to Allah.
data.etymology: Atayat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Devoted one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Atayat total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Atayat carries a strong cultural significance within the Islamic community. It emphasizes a person's deep commitment and dedication towards Allah (God) and His Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). In Islamic society, the term "Atayat" is synonymous with a person who is pious, virtuous, and deeply spiritual. This name serves as a constant reminder of one's obligations towards Allah and the importance of living a righteous life in accordance with Islamic teachings.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Atayat holds great spiritual significance as it reflects a person's inner state of devotion and love for Allah. It represents an unwavering commitment to Allah, His guidance, and His prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The name encourages its bearer to continuously strive for spiritual growth and to seek Allah's pleasure above all else. It is a reminder of the eternal nature of the soul and the importance of focusing on one's spiritual development in preparation for the afterlife.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Devoted one" symbolizes One who is devoted to Allah and His Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him).. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Atayat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of devoted one.
